VBO:0008031.summary: Quick-witted in the field and wary of unfamiliar arrivals, the Podenco Galego combines scent, hearing and sight to find quarry. This Galician hunting dog flushes rabbits and foxes from cover rather than holding a point. Its traditional search stays fairly close to a lone hunter, and at home its watchful nature can make it quick to announce strangers.
VBO:0008031.shortDescription: A wary Galician hunter that uses scent, hearing and sight to flush quarry, usually searching close to its handler.

sources.evidence: Actual Función zootécnica: carácter desconfiado e nervioso; vixiando a casa e avisando da chegada de estraños. Actual Temperamento e comportamento: cazador astuto e pícaro; levantador da peza (non mostra); uses oído e vista en apoio do olfacto; coello e raposo; no adoita afastarse en exceso, busca30–40metros arredor do cazador solitario.
